title: Montreal protest against holiday gathering restrictions
location: Montreal, Sherbrooke Street West/McGill College to Parc Lafontaine
organizer: Organizers behind Mega Family Christmas Gathering (name reported online)
threshold_50_evidence: Contemporaneous Global News calls the demonstrators hundreds, supporting threshold; 269–280 fines are not used as a crowd total.

start_date.summary: Article dates rally Sunday 20 Dec and says it began just after noon.

end_date.summary: Article describes route ending at Parc Lafontaine, both same date; no clock/end time.

location.summary: Started outside Legault’s Montreal office and proceeded to Parc Lafontaine.

participants.summary: Hundreds of demonstrators; page separately says over 1,000 had indicated interest online, not actual attendance.

demands.summary: Against recently announced Quebec holiday gathering restrictions.

state_response.summary: Police issued 269 mask fines, later said 280; no arrest claim.

notes: Origin of Global News story is uncertain because page credits Canadian Press imagery and files; do not count another CP republication as independent. Ticket totals are response/enforcement, not exact crowd total.
open_questions: Check any contemporaneous French local outlet for conflicting turnout and precise end time.

title: Edmonton Walk for Freedom against Alberta restrictions
threshold_50_evidence: Global News says hundreds gathered at the legislature; count is not separately attributed to police but explicitly tied to the Edmonton site.

start_date.summary: Report dates Edmonton rally to 12 Dec.

demands.summary: Protested provincial public-health restrictions taking effect on 13 Dec.

organizer.summary: Article associates actions with Walk for Freedom.

notes: Kept separate from same-day Calgary action because venue-specific count and organization linkage are not enough to establish one national simultaneous action.
open_questions: Find a site-specific Edmonton estimate if available.

title: Calgary Walk for Freedom against Alberta restrictions
threshold_50_evidence: Global News reports Calgary police estimate of 100–200 attendees at this location.

start_date.summary: Report dates Calgary rally to 12 Dec.

demands.summary: Protested Alberta restrictions taking effect the next day.

organizer.summary: Article links event to Walk for Freedom.

notes: Separate from Edmonton; same-day reporting alone does not establish one nationwide action.
